description: Philippine Navy helicopter mounted in a small fenced display plot beside the main gate, nose pointing north-east to Roxas Boulevard; visible and photographable from the public pavement at any hour. c/n S-168, previously registered P021, ex-Multi-Purpose Helicopter Squadron MH40. The fin currently carries 142, which Wikipedia repeats as the serial; the airframe number is 414. Installed in the mid-2010s.
